scope: Bounded primary-source novelty screen for conditional finite-replan tracking; no claim of exhaustive literature search

sources.title: Trajectory Planning and Feedforward Design for High Performance Motion Systems
sources.access: Primary six-page conference paper; introduction and formulation inspected. Journal abstract also inspected.
sources.relevance: Higher-order motion planning and model-based feedforward, including implementation and digitization, are established.

sources.title: FaSTrack: a Modular Framework for Real-Time Motion Planning and Guaranteed Safe Tracking
sources.relevance: Established tracking-error bound connecting simplified planning and higher-fidelity physical dynamics under disturbance.

sources.title: Bridging the Gap Between Safety and Real-Time Performance in Receding-Horizon Trajectory Design for Mobile Robots
sources.relevance: Tracking-error reachability and persistent feasibility already address repeated planning.

sources.title: Reachable Sets for Safe, Real-Time Manipulator Trajectory Design
sources.access: Author-deposited v2; abstract, Section II.C and conclusion inspected.
sources.relevance: Manipulator replanning includes fallback braking. Section II.C explains its kinematic trajectory scope and points to tracking-error methods.

sources.title: Jerk-limited Real-time Trajectory Generation with Arbitrary Target States
sources.access: Official RSS paper read in current project review.
sources.relevance: A richer trajectory generator than our constant-jerk certificate; not itself an uncertain-plant tracking controller.

sources.title: VeriPhy: Verified Controller Executables from Verified Cyber-Physical System Models
sources.access: Author manuscript abstract and introduction inspected.
sources.relevance: Prior formal pipeline spans physical models, runtime checks, arithmetic and controller executables; current Lean model proof is narrower.
